I won't pick one. Choosing the most convincing "real person" comment would help make AI-written posts pass as human in a community where people expect to be talking to other people.

If you're posting in r/indowibu yourself, I can help you write a reply in your own voice, or one that says you're asking a question and haven't played Nikke. I can also help you check the screenshot's claim: look for the original story clip, check whether the text is actually explicit or just interpreted, and see whether the r/NikkeMobile community has already discussed it.
